title: POC chief hails PH's best-ever performance in Youth Olympic Games
summary: The Philippines booked its best performance in the 4th Youth Olympic Games in Dakar, thanks to medals won by Naomi Marjorie Cesar and Pi Durden Forward Wangkay in athletics.
